g.text: Screened D47, other proxies, and seasonal ranges
Pink band: PETM. Tornillo model uses only screened primary micrite; dark/light orange ribbons are 80%/95% Monte Carlo intervals. BHB clumped points pass the current d18Ocarb and T47 screen.
BHB blue/purple/red bands are literature-informed CMMT/MAAT/WMMT 50%, 80%, and 95% ranges. These archives record different seasons and environmental reservoirs.
